name: Algebra 1 Course Bank Profile
role: Course-specific Bank inventory/content authority. Bank Map and Complete Bank PMs own universal execution procedure.

question_structure.rule: Use current universal Question Structure for every authored Bank question/task. Warm-Ups are outside Bank and are the explicit course exception.
question_structure.semantic_fit_rule: A structure ID cannot PASS by name alone. Evidence job, student action, structure reasoning architecture/required representation, response mode, representation mode, and executable tool/response-surface route must all agree.
question_structure.direct_read_rule: When the evidence job is only to read, identify, name, or extract a feature from a supplied representation, keep the task direct. Do not add critique, correction, construction, or extra reasoning merely to fit a more elaborate structure. Use a current direct representation-reading structure when the library supports the destination and evidence job.
question_structure.seed_exception: A seed record is not itself a finished question; when a seed becomes a question, Question Structure applies.

exit.rule: One official four-question ticket per section. Normal section = 2 current new mastery evidence questions + 2 fresh parallel reassessments of prior section carryforward pair. U1.1 = 4 opening questions; Q1-Q2 carry forward.

summative.sequence: Author V1 from the Exit/mastery evidence plan; build parallel V2-V4; then author additional secure V5-V6 under the same evidence blueprint and comparable rigor.
summative.evidence_rule: Target approximately two secure evidence opportunities per CURRENT Unit Mastery Goal.
summative.time_rule: Design the complete form for about a 40-minute class period. The Bank Map resolves exact item count from Mastery Goal count and item complexity; do not hard-code eight items across all Units.
summative.count: Evidence/time driven from the two-per-Mastery-Goal target; exact count is resolved by Bank Map.

practice_1.stage_balance: HARD: exactly 8 Intro + 8 Review + 8 Mastery. Visible stage headings are preferred for Algebra.
practice_1.allocation_rule: Within each 8-question block, distribute work for useful repetition and coverage; do not mechanically force equal I Can counts when that would create weak or fake variety.

wtc.role: Connected multipart preview/decomposition task, normally 3-5 parts with a shared stimulus/representation and real carry-forward.

seeds.role: Reusable context, data, representation, misconception, source idea, visual idea, or problem setup that may support Practice, Notes, activities, investigations, or other builds without requiring a finished duplicate question.
seeds.keep_rule: Keep a seed only when it preserves a genuinely reusable idea. Do not create filler seeds to reach a count.
seeds.approved_seed_rule: If this profile declares approved seed candidates for the requested Unit, map them unless the current teacher explicitly rejects one or a higher authority makes it invalid. No-quota means do not add filler; it does not authorize silently dropping already approved reusable seed ideas.

1.title: Relationship in Four Views
1.preserve: One coherent relationship represented consistently by table, graph, rule/equation, and context.
1.why_useful: Reusable across Notes, Practice, activities, investigations, and representation-transfer work without fixing one finished prompt.
1.may_vary: relationship values, context, which representation is given first, and which representation students create or compare

1.title: Graph Scale + Intercept
1.preserve: A coordinate graph where reading the scale matters and an intercept has mathematical or contextual meaning.
1.why_useful: Supports fresh graph-reading, scale, intercept, and parallel-evidence instances without number-only cloning.
1.may_vary: scale, plotted relationship, intercept type/value, and natural context

1.title: Function Mapping Misconception
1.preserve: The distinction that one input with two outputs is not a function while repeated outputs are allowed.
1.why_useful: Captures a durable misconception that can be represented with mappings, tables, ordered pairs, or graphs.
1.may_vary: representation type, values, and whether the relation is or is not a function

1.title: Function-Family Growth Comparison
1.preserve: A small set of values or representations that makes additive versus multiplicative or other family-change behavior visible.
1.why_useful: Supports early family recognition and comparison using evidence instead of family labels alone.
1.may_vary: family pair, table/graph/context form, values, and strength of competing evidence

1.title: Expression Error Patterns
1.preserve: High-value misconception patterns such as combining unlike terms, distributing to only one term, and sign/parentheses errors during substitution.
1.why_useful: Reusable for Notes, Practice, discussion, error analysis, and targeted recovery without fixing a single worked solution.
1.may_vary: expression, misconception selected, values, and whether the error is shown or anticipated

1.title: Equation-Model Context
1.preserve: A situation with meaningful quantities, a clearly defined unknown, an equation that matches the situation, and a solution that can be interpreted with units/meaning.
1.why_useful: Reusable for equation writing, modeling, solution interpretation, Notes, Practice, and investigations.
1.may_vary: context, quantities, equation structure, and which quantity is unknown

downstream_rules.extra_practice: Generate with Practice build using current map + Practice 1 + seeds + Question Structure.
downstream_rules.cyu: Generate with Practice build using current map + seeds + Question Structure.
downstream_rules.notes: Purpose-author/refine Examples/YTIs during Notes using Assessment Plan + Exit map + seeds + Question Structure.
downstream_rules.warmups: Generate during recurring/Practice-to-Summative work from Framework Warm-Up progression map; do not require Bank questions.

response_mode.game_exception: selected response only when a later explicit game route authorizes it
